summary: Tested new store receipt feature end-to-end (backend + web E2E). Backend endpoints /api/store/receipt/latest and /api/store/receipt/{session_id} behave as specified (404 for no purchase, 404 for unknown session, 409 for unpaid, sync-with-Square before 409). Frontend flow verified twice with real Square Sandbox test payments: (1) 7 Day Pass -> Square -> /payment-return -> /store-receipt shows PAID $80 receipt with all fields; (2) 1 Month Upfront Membership -> setup day/time chips -> Square -> /store-receipt shows PAID $190 receipt with Start date + Setup time + Key Tag + Active until. Store list renders in ~0.28s and reconcile runs in background (no longer blocks load). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (~3.5k lines). Consider splitting membership/store endpoints into a router module for maintainability, though not blocking.

In memberships.tsx buy() fallback message ('Still processing...') is only shown on native after 20*1.5s polling; on web the flow relies on payment-return -> /store-receipt(latest). No issue but a small refactor to unify the two flows would reduce code branches.
seed_data_creation: Two paid store transactions were created for member1@gmail.com during E2E testing (a 7 Day Pass and a 1 Month Upfront Membership via Square Sandbox). These extended the member's membership_expires_at and are visible via /api/store/receipt/latest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: E2E web flow: Square Sandbox Testing Panel does NOT auto-redirect the browser after 'Test Payment' — you must navigate to /payment-return?status=success&store=1 yourself to simulate the customer return. /payment-return then auto-forwards to /store-receipt within ~1.4s. The backend detects paid via net_amount_due==0 + tender even though the sandbox order state stays OPEN. Test credentials: member1@gmail.com / Password123 (this account may already have active membership from prior tests — cosmetic only). The setup modal chips are inside a ScrollView; use scroll_into_view_if_needed() before clicking chips beyond index ~2, or the click will fail with 'Element is outside of the viewport'.
rca_of_issue: Original user-reported issue (no receipt after store purchase + slow store) is fully resolved. Fix: (a) new GET /api/store/receipt/latest + /api/store/receipt/{session_id} endpoints trigger Square sync before returning receipt data; (b) new /store-receipt screen that polls up to 6x /latest until receipt is available; (c) /payment-return now forwards to /store-receipt when params.store is set; (d) memberships.tsx moved api.reconcilePayments() off the critical path so product list renders immediately (~0.28s in E2E).
